summary: Settings visual system — compact, coherent and tactile

changes.title: Unified settings navigation
changes.detail: Adopt a restrained list-first visual system with shared row geometry, monochrome accent icons, neutral light and dark surfaces, compact search/navigation and a functional typing preview without decorative mock keyboard.

changes.title: Tactile shared controls
changes.detail: Use consistent capsule switches and sliders, fixed slider measurement during press, accessible row-level toggles, unified checkmark choices, multiselect checkboxes and segmented options.

changes.title: Consistent editors and management
changes.detail: Apply the same palette, spacing and shapes to Glass Studio, voice model choices, app profiles, editing gestures, pickers, dialogs, reorder lists, reset and version history. Existing settings values and protected access are retained; keyboard renderer and motion untouched.
